summary: Bottle Rocket is a self-hosted document scanning and management application designed to handle specific file formats like Rocketbook and Scribzee. It processes digital scans and organises them within a centralised repository on your own hardware. The project is available under an MIT licence and is built using C#.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you specifically use Rocketbook or Scribzee formats and want an independent, local system to store and organise your scanned documents.
watchOut: With a relatively low repository star count and slowing maintenance indicators, you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack community support when adopting this software.
deployNotes: As a Docker container running on C#, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your document database and place the application behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
